SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0) AS total_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 0 AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 0 AND is_deleted = 0) AS progress_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 1 AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND done = 1 AND is_deleted = 0) AS complete_count

SELECT total_recent.board_type AS boardType, total_recent.num, total_recent.atcId, total_recent.title, total_recent.content, total_recent.category, total_recent.done, total_recent.created_at AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT '습득' AS board_type, num, atc_id AS atcId, fd_prdt_nm AS title, fd_sbjt AS content, prdt_cl_nm AS category, done, created_at FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '분실' AS board_type, num, atc_id AS atcId, lst_prdt_nm AS title, lst_sbjt AS content, prdt_cl_nm AS category, done, created_at FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ) AS total_recent ORDER BY total_recent.created_at DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT total_recent.boardType, total_recent.num, total_recent.title, total_recent.content, total_recent.category, total_recent.done, total_recent.createdAt, total_recent.atcId FROM ( SELECT '습득' AS boardType, num, fd_prdt_nm AS title, fd_sbjt AS content, prdt_cl_nm AS category, done, created_at AS createdAt, atc_id AS atcId FROM found WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '분실' AS boardType, num, lst_prdt_nm AS title, lst_sbjt AS content, prdt_cl_nm AS category, done, created_at AS createdAt, atc_id AS atcId FROM lost WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ) AS total_recent ORDER BY total_recent.createdAt DESC

SELECT fc.comment_num AS commentNum, fc.id, fc.num, fc.data_source AS dataSource, fc.content AS content, fc.created_at AS createdAt, fc.updated_at AS updatedAt, fc.is_deleted AS isDeleted, f.fd_prdt_nm AS postTitle, f.atc_id AS atcId, '습득' AS boardType, IFNULL(f.is_deleted, 1) AS postDeleted FROM found_comment fc LEFT JOIN found f ON fc.num = f.num WHERE fc.id = #{userId} AND fc.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT lc.comment_num AS commentNum, lc.id, lc.num, lc.data_source AS dataSource, lc.content AS content, lc.created_at AS createdAt, lc.updated_at AS updatedAt, lc.is_deleted AS isDeleted, l.lst_prdt_nm AS postTitle, l.atc_id AS atcId, '분실' AS boardType, IFNULL(l.is_deleted, 1) AS postDeleted FROM lost_comment lc LEFT JOIN lost l ON lc.num = l.num WHERE lc.id = #{userId} AND lc.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY updatedAt DESC
